## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Related issue

Link the issue. Use a closing reference only if this PR meets all acceptance
criteria; explain PR-only scope for a small mechanical fix.

## Validation

Record commands and results, relevant CI/hardware evidence, and remaining
limitations or linked follow-up issues.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the relevant focused tests and the required repository validation.
- [ ] I updated affected contracts/guides and linked the issue or justified PR-only scope.
- [ ] I preserved applicable third-party license and attribution notices.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by:` trailer (`git commit -s`).
